test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Worth
solution:
The correct answer is Value.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Worth** refers to having a specific monetary value.

 
 
• **Example:** **Our house is worth 2 crores.**
 
 
 
• **Value** refers to the amount of money that can be received for something.
